lore_anchors.definition: In Xianxia cosmology, a vow sworn under the Heavenly Dao that binds the swearer to absolute consequences; breaking it can trigger immediate karmic tribulation or spontaneous death. Cultivators treat it as a last-resort commitment.

A metaphysical reward from the universe for virtuous deeds; a bearer of great karmic merit has a naturally blessed foundation, making them prized disciples and making it dangerous for Immortals to harm them due to karmic backlash.
The elite demonic enforcement corps of the Firewing Fiend King, deployed to hunt down the Qi Kingdom’s remnants.
The fourth major Ki Refining realm; the cultivator develops a miniature cosmos within their Violet Palace—stars, moon, and sun—for vastly accelerated energy absorption.

A cultivator whose physical body was destroyed during tribulation but whose nascent soul survived; they live in constant fear of recurring tribulations and are generally weaker than true Celestial Immortals.
The twelve supreme demon lords ruling the Eastern Stream region of the Star Continent; each commands vast territories and legions of demonic subordinates.
A forbidden technique that forcibly reads a victim’s memories; often fatal or mind-destroying for the target, considered a taboo in most orthodox sects.
